_comment: Jira and Confluence export for sprintkit. Jira gets epics, stories, sprints, sub-tasks and comments. Confluence, when enabled, gets the planning documents, and every Jira web link to a document points at the Confluence page instead of the git host. The two sections are independent. When a section is off, missing or incomplete, sprintkit never connects for it but still writes planning/scratchpad/jira-export.md and jira-comments.md, and planning/scratchpad/jira-mapping.json. No credentials here: login goes through the Atlassian MCP (OAuth).
_site: Your Atlassian Cloud address, e.g. your-company.atlassian.net. Shared by Jira and Confluence. Preflight stops if the connected site differs.

jira._enabled: true to export to Jira. false skips Jira entirely.
jira._project-prefix: Must equal the Jira project key. Jira builds issue keys from it (TDA gives TDA-12). It cannot be changed here without changing the Jira project.
jira._board-id: The board that holds the sprints. Find it in the board URL (.../boards/42).
jira._levels: What to export, in creation order: epics, stories, sprints, subtasks, comments. Remove any you do not want. comments posts the agents' recorded decisions, one comment per decision, append-only.

confluence._enabled: true to publish the planning documents to Confluence. false (or deleting this section) skips Confluence; Jira links then point at the git host.
confluence._space-key: Key of an existing Confluence space (the short code in .../wiki/spaces/<KEY>/...). Preflight stops if it does not exist.
confluence._parent-page: Title of the page every document is created under. Created in the space if missing.
confluence._documents: Which documents to publish: prd, constitution, sprint-plan, specs, sprint-graph, retros, ux, adr. Remove any you do not want. Markdown stays the source of truth; pages are overwritten on every run, so edit the markdown, not the page.
confluence._link-from-jira: true: Jira web links to a document use the Confluence page URL. false, or no page yet: they use the git host permalink.
